remaining_native_work: select the actual target and obtain the separately controlled campaign authority
execute applicable native observations against the exact selected tuple and topology
retain failed, blocked and superseded attempts rather than overwriting history
collect controlled evidence, provenance, positive controls, freshness and reviewer records
record explicit not-applicable decisions and every residual campaign gap
submit the current complete packet to the independent qualification authority
allow the PlatformProfile dossier to publish only evidence that still matches the current campaign packet

authorization_binding.contact_expiry_semantics: Completed evidence remains eligible only for observations collected within the authorized window; expiry blocks new target interaction but does not erase prior observations.
